content.short: We democratize smart contracts by turning Plutus code into simple online forms.
content.description:
Our mission is to lower the barrier to entry for web3 communities and individuals to interact with smart contracts. We wrap smart contracts in an easy to use interface to provide a robust and no code solution for people to create, manage, and execute smart contracts. We also provide tools to Cardano communities looking to operate as DAOs. We are part of a handful of projects and initiatives in the ecosystem. Clarity Protocol: A DAO Tooling Protocol Create and manage DAOs without writing any code. Establish governance rules and execute votes on-chain. Manage treasury funds. Contribute to Clarity's open smart contract library to earn rewards: The Clarity protocol will be a community driven protocol by creating incentives for everyone to contribute. You can read more about this in our whitepaper in the “Clarity Protocol Overview” section. Now accepting applicants for our Clarity DAO Incubator: The Clarity DAO Incubator aims to help fund and grow Cardano communities that want to operate on chain. NFT minting services: From layers to mint site Use our CNFT generation bot to randomize layered artwork based on a predetermined rarity chart. Upload CNFT's to the Cardano blockchain. Mint your CNFT's from any website: CC bot: Discord Management Verify ownership of CNFT's by Policy ID. Verify delegation to specific Stake Pool by Pool ID. Add/remove roles based on CNFT/Delegation status. Provide exclusive access to content based on role managed by CC Bot. Escrow Service: A secure platform for executing agreements on-chain Control escrow agreements on Cardano using manual user input to verify completion of agreements. Securely transfer Cardano Native Assets. Assign an arbitrator to fairly resolve disputes on-chain. You can see how we do this in this video ‍
